parsed.post: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 8 significantly improved val_bpb from 1.1078 to 1.0357. Capacity seems to be a major lever. Next, I will explore increasing MATRIX_LR to see if we can push the limit further with this larger model.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 on the new DEPTH=8 baseline to maximize learning efficiency.
